title:
Write a complete, natural product title for a WooCommerce store listing -- a real shoppable title a customer would read, NOT a short code, abbreviation, or single keyword. It must be a full phrase of at least 6-10 words describing what the product actually is.

Follow this exact field order: [Product Type] + [Brand] + [Model] + [Key Technical Specification] + [Variant]. Always lead with what the product IS (the product type), then the brand/model it's for or made by, then the one or two most important technical details, then the variant (color/size) if given.

Target length: up to {max_chars} characters (use the space -- do not stop short just because you could). Plain text only.

Example of the right shape (for a different product): "Magnetic Leather Wallet Case for Samsung Galaxy S26 with Card Holder - Black" -- notice the product type (Magnetic Leather Wallet Case) comes FIRST, before the brand/model (Samsung Galaxy S26).
Example of what NOT to return: "MagCase", "S26C", "Skins" (too short, not real titles) -- or "Samsung Galaxy S26 Magnetic Leather Wallet Case - Black" (wrong order: brand/model should not lead).

{language_instruction}

{ctx}

Return ONLY the title text.
description:
Write an HTML product description for a WooCommerce store. Use

and

  • tags only. Write ONLY the sections listed below, in this exact priority order: {structure}. Each section must be genuinely distinct content -- do not merge sections together into one undifferentiated block. What belongs in each section, when requested: - intro: a short opening paragraph introducing what the product is and its main use case. - features: a bullet list of concrete technical specifications and capabilities (materials, ratings, dimensions, included parts). - benefits: a SEPARATE paragraph or short bullet list describing the customer VALUE and OUTCOME -- what the customer gains or experiences -- NOT a repeat of the technical specs already covered in features. - compatibility: a short paragraph or line explicitly stating which device(s), model(s), or use case(s) this product is compatible with or designed for. - closing: a short closing paragraph, e.g. a call to action. If a requested section has genuinely nothing distinct to say (e.g. no compatibility info exists in the product data), you may omit that section entirely rather than repeating content from another section just to fill it. Keep the total visible text (excluding HTML tags) under {max_chars} characters. Be factual, professional, and SEO-friendly. Every sentence and bullet point must be a complete, grammatically correct thought -- never a sentence fragment or a bare keyword. If the character budget is too small to cover every requested section in full, complete sentences, DROP the lowest-priority sections entirely rather than compressing all of them into fragments. A short, complete, well-written description covering fewer points is always better than one that mentions everything but reads as broken phrases. {language_instruction} {ctx} Return ONLY the HTML. No explanation, no markdown.
